description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2920013291371 STARTER,ENGINE,ELEC: Line 0001 Qty 25 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0063 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
